Let $X$ be a metric space and $a\in\mathbb N$, and assume a `DoublingMeasure X (2^a)` structure on $X$ (the constant is `defaultA a` $=2^a$; by its docstring, a doubling metric measure space): that is, $X$ is complete and locally compact and carries a Borel measure $\mu$ (the measure `volume`) that is locally finite, not the zero measure, and doubling, $\mu(B(z,2ho))\le 2^a\,\mu(B(z,ho))$ for all $z\in X$ and $ho\in\mathbb R$. Let $K:X	imes X	o\mathbb C$ be a two-sided Calderón–Zygmund kernel with parameter $a$ (`IsTwoSidedKernel a K`), i.e., writing $C_K(a)=2^{a^3}$ (`C_K a`) and $V(z,y)=\mu(B(z,d(z,y)))$: $K$ is measurable on $X	imes X$; $|K(z,y)|\le C_K(a)/V(z,y)$ for all $z,y\in X$ (with $V$ taken as a real number); $|K(z,y)-K(z,y')|\le (d(y,y')/d(z,y))^{1/a}\,C_K(a)/V(z,y)$ whenever $2d(y,y')\le d(z,y)$; and $|K(z,y)-K(z',y)|\le (d(z,z')/d(z,y))^{1/a}\,C_K(a)/V(z,y)$ in $[0,\infty]$ whenever $2d(z,z')\le d(z,y)$. Assume a `CompatibleFunctions ℝ X (2^a)` structure: a type $\Theta(X)$ with an injective map (`coeΘ`) into the continuous functions $X	o\mathbb R$, through which each $	heta\in\Theta(X)$ is applied to points of $X$, and for each $w\in X$, $ho\in\mathbb R$ a pseudometric $d_{w,ho}$ on $\Theta(X)$, such that: some point of $X$ is a common zero of all $	heta\in\Theta(X)$; $\sup_{y,y'\in B(w,ho)}|	heta(y)-\vartheta(y)-	heta(y')+\vartheta(y')|\le d_{w,ho}(	heta,\vartheta)$; $d_{w_1,ho_1}\le d_{w_2,ho_2}$ whenever $B(w_1,ho_1)\subseteq B(w_2,ho_2)$; $d_{w_2,2ho}\le 2^a d_{w_1,ho}$ whenever $d(w_1,w_2)<2ho$; $2d_{w_1,ho}\le d_{w_2,2^aho}$ whenever $B(w_1,ho)\subseteq B(w_2,2^aho)$; and for every $w,ho$ and every radius $\lambda$, each $d_{w,ho}$-ball of radius $2\lambda$ in $\Theta(X)$ is covered by at most $2^a$ $d_{w,ho}$-balls of radius $\lambda$. Assume $\Theta(X)$ is $(1/a)$-cancellative (`IsCancellative X (defaultτ a)`, with `defaultτ a` $=1/a$): for all $z\in X$, real $ho>0$, $\varphi:X	o\mathbb C$ with $\{\varphi
e0\}\subseteq B(z,ho)$ and finite inhomogeneous Lipschitz norm $\|\varphi\|_{\mathrm{Lip}(z,ho)}=\sup_{B(z,ho)}|\varphi|+ho\,\sup_{y
e y'\in B(z,ho)}|\varphi(y)-\varphi(y')|/d(y,y')$ (`iLipENorm`), and all $	heta,\vartheta\in\Theta(X)$: $ ig|\int_X e^{\mathrm i(	heta(y)-\vartheta(y))}\varphi(y)\,d\mu(y) ig|\le 2^a\,\mu(B(z,ho))\,\|\varphi\|_{\mathrm{Lip}(z,ho)}\,(1+d_{z,ho}(	heta,\vartheta))^{-1/a}$ in $[0,\infty]$. For $t\in\mathbb R$, $h:X	o\mathbb C$ and $z\in X$ let $T_t h(z)=\int_{X\setminus B(z,t)}K(z,y)\,h(y)\,d\mu(y)$ (`czOperator K t h z`, a Bochner integral; by its docstring the Calderón–Zygmund operator $T_t$). Say that an operator $T$ taking functions $X	o\mathbb C$ to functions $X	o\mathbb C$ has bounded strong type $(2,2)$ with constant $C\in[0,\infty]$ (`HasBoundedStrongType T 2 2 μ μ C`) if for every $h:X	o\mathbb C$ that is essentially bounded ($h\in L^\infty(\mu)$), a.e.-strongly measurable, and whose support $\{h
e0\}$ has finite $\mu$-measure (`BoundedFiniteSupport h μ`), the function $Th$ is a.e.-strongly measurable and $\|Th\|_{L^2(\mu)}\le C\,\|h\|_{L^2(\mu)}$. Let $q,q'\in\mathbb R_{\ge0}$ with $q\in(1,2]$ and $q'$ the Hölder conjugate of $q$ ($1/q+1/q'=1$), let $F,G\subseteq X$ be measurable sets, and assume $a\ge4$ and that for every real $t>0$ the operator $T_t$ has bounded strong type $(2,2)$ with constant $C_{Ts}(a)=2^{a^3}$ (`C_Ts a`). Define the generalized Carleson operator (`carlesonOperator K f x`) by $\mathcal C f(x)=\sup_{	heta\in\Theta(X)}\sup_{0<R_1<R_2}\Big|\int_{\{y:\,R_1<d(x,y)<R_2\}}K(x,y)\,f(y)\,e^{\mathrm i	heta(y)}\,d\mu(y)\Big|\in[0,\infty]$. Let $C_{10.0.1}(a,q)=C_K(a)^2\cdot C_{1.0.2}(a,q)\in\mathbb R_{\ge0}$ (`C10_0_1 a q`), where $C_{1.0.2}(a,q)=2^{(3𝕔+18+5\lfloor 𝕔/4floor)a^3}/(q-1)^6$ (`C1_0_2 a q`, with $𝕔$ the project's fixed natural-number constant `𝕔`, whose docstring says it is fixed equal to $100$ following the blueprint, and $\lfloor𝕔/4floor$ natural-number division). Then for every measurable $f:X	o\mathbb C$ with $|f(x)|\le\mathbf 1_F(x)$ for all $x\in X$, $$\int^-_G \mathcal C f(x)\,d\mu(x)\le C_{10.0.1}(a,q)\,\mu(G)^{1/q'}\,\mu(F)^{1/q}$$ in $[0,\infty]$ (lower Lebesgue integral over $G$).
